# FoundFolios

> > FoundFolios is a creative portfolio platform showcasing professional photographers, illustrators, and artist representation agencies across commercial, editorial, and fine art disciplines.

The platform features diverse creative talent including fashion photographers like Lindsay Adler, illustrators such as Vlad Alvarez and ARTMAN, and artist agencies like Blasco Creative Artists and Schumann and Company. FoundFolios serves as a discovery hub for commercial and editorial creative work, with strong representation in advertising, portrait, architecture, and illustration portfolios.

## Key Topics

- Photography portfolios
- Editorial photography
- Commercial illustration
- Portrait photography
- Artist representation agencies
- Fashion photography
- Advertising creative work
- Architecture photography
- Celebrity photography
- Book cover illustration
- Corporate portraits
- Fine art photography
- Creative agency rosters
- Emerging creative talent
